cases.question: 订单总数是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM salesorderheader

cases.question: 2003 年的销售总额是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT SUM(TotalDue) AS total FROM salesorderheader WHERE OrderDate >= '2003-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2004-01-01'

cases.question: 各大类的销售金额分别是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT pc.Name, SUM(sod.LineTotal) AS amt FROM salesorderdetail sod JOIN product p ON p.ProductID = sod.ProductID JOIN productsubcategory ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN productcategory pc ON pc.ProductCategoryID = ps.ProductCategoryID GROUP BY pc.Name
cases.note: 三层雪花：明细 → 产品 → 子类 → 大类

cases.question: 各销售区域的订单数是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT st.Name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM salesorderheader soh JOIN customer c ON c.CustomerID = soh.CustomerID JOIN salesterritory st ON st.TerritoryID = c.TerritoryID GROUP BY st.Name
cases.note: 订单 → 客户 → 区域，两跳

cases.question: 线上订单占比是多少？用 0 到 1 之间的小数表示
cases.goldSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN OnlineOrderFlag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM salesorderheader

cases.question: 销售金额最高的 5 个产品是什么？
cases.goldSql: SELECT p.Name, SUM(sod.LineTotal) AS amt FROM salesorderdetail sod JOIN product p ON p.ProductID = sod.ProductID GROUP BY p.Name ORDER BY amt DESC LIMIT 5
